# AtomCode

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | English

An (unofficial) provider plugin for [magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) that brings **ATOMCODE (AtomGit CodingPlan)** in.

After signing in through AtomGit or reusing the official AtomCode CLI's local
sign-in, the CodingPlan models appear in magpie as the **ATOMCODE** provider.
Any agent — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode — can use `atomcode/<model>`. The plan,
the daily check-in and rolling quota windows show up on the account row, in
`magpie quota`, and in settings.

```
Agent (Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / …)
   │ any API
   ▼
magpie gateway ──► magpie-atomcode (adds atomcode-signing-v1 headers + UA)
   ▼
https://llm-api.atomgit.com/v1 (OpenAI-compatible, SSE streams back untouched)
```

## Features

- **Two sign-in methods**: browser OAuth via the AtomGit broker, or reuse of
  `~/.atomcode/auth.toml` from the official AtomCode CLI. CLI-backed accounts
  are re-read before use and renewed tokens are atomically written back with
  `0600` permissions.
- **Resilient renewal**: single-flight refresh plus an in-memory result cache
  prevents a rotated refresh token from being reused; a gateway 401 retries
  once with a fresh token, including on older hosts without `auth.refresh`.
- **Direct to AtomGit**: no Atom2Api instance needed; streaming, tool calls and
  reasoning-effort variants are declared to the host.
- **Daily check-in (`checkin`)**: scheduled by magpie's native check-in toggle. Plan valid → done; expired/missing → the official Max→Pro→Lite cascade re-claims it; quota exhausted → failed with the upstream reason.
- **Quota windows**: plan name, expiry, every upstream rate-limit window, and a
  token window only when upstream supplies token-specific fields without call
  counters (or explicitly declares token units), updating live.
- **Native controls**: `auto_claim` and `auto_version` appear as provider
  switches in Magpie and default on; the older camelCase options still override
  them for compatibility.
- **Restart-safe fallback**: the last successful model catalog and quota
  snapshot survive restarts. A transient refresh failure shows the stale quota
  with a clear marker instead of blanking the account row.
- **Auto version tracking**: follows the AtomCode repo's current version by default (the official client force-updates); falls back to the built-in anchor, never blocking a request.
- **Live model catalog**: each account pulls its own (varies by plan/tier), with a built-in snapshot as the offline fallback.
- **Offline diagnostics**: a loopback-only troubleshooting workspace at
  `http://127.0.0.1:3478/` summarizes local readiness, quota windows, model
  catalog, account and version state, then offers a network-free signature
  self-check and a human-readable redacted report. It opens inside Magpie's
  sandboxed plugin frame or directly in a browser.

## Current models (snapshot 2026-11-02)

| Model | Context | Reasoning efforts | Vision |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glm5.3-flash` | 512K | low / high | ✓ |
| `qwen3.8-27b` | 256K | low / medium / xhigh | ✓ |
| `deepseek-flash` | 1M | high / max | ✓ |

The catalog varies per account and plan — the live list wins after sign-in.

## Install

```bash
magpie plugin add @jianmu-plugins/opencode-atomcode-auth
# Or load a checkout directly:
magpie plugin add /path/to/plugins/packages/atomcode
```

The package targets magpie `>=0.1.2629`. It exposes separate OpenCode 1.x and
2.x entry points, but real OpenCode host-contract verification remains
experimental.

## Sign in & check-in

```bash
magpie plugin login atomcode 1   # browser OAuth
magpie plugin login atomcode 2   # reuse the official AtomCode CLI login
```

- CLI reuse reads `~/.atomcode/auth.toml`, verifies that it is a private regular
  file, and refuses to follow symlinks or wide permissions. Renewals are written
  back atomically so the official CLI and magpie keep the same refresh chain.
- The second sign-in method asks for an optional `auth.toml` path. Leave it blank
  for the default, or enter an absolute path / `~/...`; relative paths and
  `~other-user` are rejected.
- The local CLI file is shared state. If its account changes, sign in again so
  magpie never signs requests with one account's `uid` and another account's
  access token.
- The official CLI serializes renewals with `auth-refresh.lock`. This plugin
  does not take that Rust `fs2` lock. If both renew at the same instant and the
  broker rotates the refresh token, the client that loses the race must sign in
  again.
- Check-in: the toggle in magpie's plugin settings ("has the ATOMCODE plugin sign in every signed-in account, daily"). Even when off, an expired plan is re-claimed automatically while reading quota/catalog (30-min cooldown).
- Plan quotas: Lite 1000/day; Pro trial 100/day released at 10:00. When the daily pool is out, the check-in fails with the upstream message — try again tomorrow.

## Options (`options` in `plugins.json`; all have defaults)

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `locale` | auto | `zh` / `en` |
| `autoVersion` | `true` | legacy override for the native `auto_version` switch |
| `clientVersion` | `5.2.3` | fallback version anchor (used when `autoVersion` is off or the fetch fails) |
| `autoClaim` | `true` | legacy override for the native `auto_claim` switch |
| `masterKeyHex` | built-in | escape hatch when upstream rotates its signing key |
| `platformBaseURL` | `https://acs.atomgit.com` | OAuth broker |
| `codingPlanAPIURL` | `https://api.gitcode.com/api/v5` | CodingPlan REST |
| `quotaTtlMs` | `60000` | quota cache |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `32768` | default model output ceiling |
| `diagnosticsPort` | `3478` | loopback diagnostics port (must stay in `1024..65535`) |

`auto_claim` and `auto_version` are the preferred controls and default on. Set
them in the provider editor or with:

```bash
magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_claim":false}'
magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_version":false}'
```

The manifest defaults each AtomCode account to 8 simultaneous requests. This
helps when several agents, sessions or sub-tasks run in parallel; it does not
make a single streamed completion faster. A controlled live probe at 4, 8 and
12 simultaneous short requests returned HTTP 200 without 429 or 5xx responses,
so 8 is the conservative default and the provider editor can override it.

## Security boundaries

All of these are enforced in code, and `npm test` covers each one:

- **The gateway is the only destination.** `loader.fetch` freezes the validated
  URL before any asynchronous credential read, then compares its origin against
  `https://llm-api.atomgit.com`. A caller cannot mutate a `URL` object during the
  await and redirect signed traffic. Scheme and port are part of the comparison.
- **Upstream cannot move the destination.** A model row's `base_url` is honoured only when its origin exactly matches the signed gateway; otherwise that model falls back to the official gateway and the plugin logs that it did.
- **Endpoint options use exact hosts.** `platformBaseURL` may only be
  `acs.atomgit.com`; `codingPlanAPIURL` may only be `api.gitcode.com` (path
  overrides are allowed). Both must be HTTPS on port 443. Anything else falls
  back to the official endpoint with a redacted warning.
- **Bounded reads and redirects.** Version, OAuth and CodingPlan response bodies are capped at 1 MiB *while* streaming; every metadata call has a timeout and refuses redirects. A broker-supplied login URL must also stay on AtomGit.
- **Signable request bodies only.** Strings, byte buffers, typed arrays,
  `ArrayBuffer` and `Blob` are signed exactly as sent. Streams, `FormData` and
  `URLSearchParams` are rejected rather than signing bytes that differ from the
  wire representation. Buffered request bodies are capped at 64 MiB.
- **Final bytes are signed.** Streaming Chat Completions requests without an
  explicit `stream_options.include_usage` receive `include_usage: true`; the
  signature is computed after serialization.
- **Logs are redacted.** Upstream response bodies are not copied into errors,
  and invalid option values, bearer tokens, emails and long secrets are not
  logged.
- **Credential failures are separated from entitlement failures.** A 401 or an
  explicit credential/session 403 may trigger one refresh. Quota, plan,
  permission and other non-credential 403 responses keep the account signed in
  and return `x-magpie-sign-in: kept`.
- **Diagnostics stay local and read-only.** The service listens only on
  `127.0.0.1`, checks the request `Host`, requires a random per-process token for
  APIs, checks `Origin` on POST, and serves a restrictive CSP. The page never
  probes AtomGit or the LLM gateway.

Browser credentials live in magpie's own store. CLI credentials stay in
`~/.atomcode/auth.toml`; renewals are atomically replaced with `0600`
permissions while unrelated TOML content is preserved. Credentials are never
printed or logged and are only attached to the exact official hosts above.

Magpie also writes `<plugin data directory>/atomcode-state.json` for the
diagnostics view. It is schema-filtered and atomically written with `0600`
permissions. It may contain model names, quota windows, version provenance and
a redacted last error, but never tokens, a full user id, email addresses,
prompts or raw upstream responses.

### What runs by default

Both defaults are on out of the box, and both act without being asked:

| Default | What it actually does | Turn off with |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_claim: true` | Starts the CodingPlan `claim-v2` after sign-in and retries the idempotent claim when the plan has expired. After sign-in it runs in the background. | `magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_claim":false}'` |
| `auto_version: true` | Refreshes the version manifest from `raw.atomgit.com` in the background (12 h cache). Requests immediately use the current cached version, including the built-in fallback. | `magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_version":false}'` |

## Troubleshooting

For a 401 during sign-in or provider testing:

1. Run `magpie version` and note the failure stage: OAuth callback, model catalog, quota, or chat request.
2. Open the plugin's **AtomCode diagnostics** page. The status summary separates local readability from upstream availability; quota, model, account and version details follow, with the redacted last error, offline self-check and expandable runtime metadata below.
3. Try `atomcode login` with the official AtomCode client using the same account. If that also returns 401, the account is likely refused upstream rather than by this plugin.
4. Open a bug report with the redacted report from the diagnostics page. Never include access tokens, refresh tokens, OAuth state, `plugin-auth.json`, email addresses, account IDs, or unredacted home-directory paths.

Security issues should follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Development and review expectations are in the [community plugin guide](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins#write-your-own).

## Development

```bash
cd ../..
npm test                       # Node test suite from the workspace root
npm run test:bun               # Bun host/runtime suite
npm run test:coverage:enforce  # line/branch/function gates
npm run pack:check             # verify the published tarball contents
```

Live validation spends a small amount of quota and is disabled by default:

```bash
ATOMCODE_LIVE=1 npm run test:live
```

It is capped at nine requests, disables automatic claiming, never runs check-in,
and prints no tokens, prompts or model response text.

CI runs the suite on Node 20, 22 and 24 plus a pinned Bun, enforces coverage
thresholds, and installs the packed tarball into a clean project for an import
smoke test. Release publishing is prepared through npm trusted publishing with
provenance and is triggered only by a GitHub release.

Sandbox verification (never touches your real magpie):

```bash
SB=$(mktemp -d)
PLUGIN_ROOT="$(pwd)/packages/atomcode"
sb() { env HOME="$SB" USERPROFILE="$SB" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$SB/.config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$SB/.cache" \
  MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 MAGPIE_PLUGIN_MARKET=off magpie "$@"; }
sb plugin add "$PLUGIN_ROOT"
sb plugin list
sb plugin options atomcode
```

The same code loads as an OpenCode plugin (v1 shape); magpie-only hooks
(`auth.usage`, `auth.refresh`, `auth.checkin`) are ignored by OpenCode. OpenCode
support remains experimental because its OAuth type does not declare the `uid`
field required by AtomCode request signing. The diagnostics service and native
provider switches are Magpie-only.

## Disclaimer

Unofficial, not affiliated with or endorsed by AtomGit / AtomCode. Upstream protocols may change at any time; usage you choose may breach terms of service and risks account restriction or bans — Atom2Api carries the same warning. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for attribution.

# AtomCode

简体中文 | [English](README.md)

把 **ATOMCODE（AtomGit CodingPlan）** 接入 [magpie](https://usemagpie.ai) 的供应商插件（非官方）。

通过 AtomGit 浏览器授权，或复用本机官方 AtomCode CLI 的登录后，CodingPlan
的模型会以供应商 **ATOMCODE** 出现在 magpie 里；Claude Code、Codex、
OpenCode 等任何 Agent 都能选 `atomcode/<模型>` 使用。套餐信息、每日签到与
滚动额度窗口，都显示在 magpie 的账号行、`magpie quota` 和设置里。

```
Agent (Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / …)
   │ 任意 API
   ▼
magpie 网关 ──► magpie-atomcode（补 atomcode-signing-v1 签名 + UA）
   ▼
https://llm-api.atomgit.com/v1（OpenAI 兼容，SSE 原样流回）
```

## 功能

- **两种登录方式**：AtomGit 浏览器 OAuth，或复用官方 AtomCode CLI 的
  `~/.atomcode/auth.toml`。CLI 来源每次请求前重读；续期结果以 `0600`
  权限原子回写，不破坏无关 TOML 内容。
- **可靠续期**：刷新单飞加内存结果缓存，避免 refresh token 轮换后被旧 token
  再刷一次；网关返回 401 时会强制续期并只重试一次，旧宿主没有
  `auth.refresh` 也能工作。
- **直连 AtomGit**：不需要 Atom2Api 常驻；流式、工具调用和推理档位 variants
  都声明给宿主。
- **每日签到（checkin）**：magpie 原生签到开关调度。套餐有效 → done；到期/缺失 → 按官方 Max→Pro→Lite 级联自动重领；名额满 → failed 并显示上游原因。
- **额度窗口**：显示套餐名、到期时间、上游返回的每个限流窗口；只有上游给出
  token 专用字段且没有调用计数（或明确声明 token 单位）时才显示 token 窗口。
- **原生开关**：`auto_claim` / `auto_version` 会出现在 Magpie 供应商设置里，
  默认开启；旧的 camelCase 选项仍可覆盖它们，保持兼容。
- **重启后可恢复**：最近一次成功的模型目录与额度快照会落盘。临时刷新失败时
  显示带 `stale` 标记的旧额度，而不是把账号行清空。
- **自动追版本**：默认跟随 AtomCode 官方仓库的最新版本号（官方客户端会强制更新），拉取失败退回内置版本，绝不阻塞请求。
- **模型目录动态拉取**：每个账号自己的目录（随套餐/档位而变），离线时用内置快照兜底。
- **离线诊断页**：`http://127.0.0.1:3478/` 是只读排障工作台，先说明本地
  快照是否可读，再展示额度窗口、模型目录、账号与版本状态；下方提供脱敏最近
  错误、不访问上游的签名自检和可展开的运行时信息。既可显示在 Magpie 的沙箱
  插件页面里，也可直接在浏览器打开。

## 当前模型（2026-11-02 实测快照）

| 模型 | 上下文 | 推理档位 | 视觉 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glm5.3-flash` | 500K | low / high | ✓ |
| `qwen3.8-27b` | 256K | low / medium / xhigh | ✓ |
| `deepseek-flash` | 1M | high / max | ✓ |

目录随账号与套餐动态变化，以登录后拉取的为准。

## 安装

```bash
# 社区/npm 包
magpie plugin add @jianmu-plugins/opencode-atomcode-auth
# 或直接加载仓库目录
magpie plugin add /path/to/plugins/packages/atomcode
```

包面向 magpie `>=0.1.2629`。OpenCode 1.x 与 2.x 使用各自的入口，但真实
OpenCode 宿主契约尚未验证，因此仍标为实验性。

## 登录与签到

```bash
magpie plugin login atomcode 1   # 浏览器 OAuth
magpie plugin login atomcode 2   # 复用本机 AtomCode CLI 登录
```

- CLI 复用会读取 `~/.atomcode/auth.toml`，只接受权限不宽于 `0600` 的普通文件，
  拒绝符号链接；续期后原子回写，让官方 CLI 与 magpie 保持同一条 refresh 链。
- 第二种登录方式会询问可选的 `auth.toml` 路径。留空使用默认路径，也可以填
  绝对路径或 `~/...`；相对路径与 `~其他用户` 会被拒绝。
- 该文件是 CLI 与插件共享状态。如果本机登录切换了账号，需要重新登录 magpie，
  避免用一个账号的 `uid` 给另一个账号的 access token 签名。
- 官方 CLI 使用 `auth-refresh.lock` 串行化续期；本插件不持有同款 Rust `fs2`
  文件锁。如果双方在同一时刻续期且 broker 轮换了 refresh token，竞争失败的
  一方需要重新登录。
- 签到：magpie 设置 → 插件里的签到开关（「每天让 ATOMCODE 插件给每个已登录的账号签到一次」）。即使不开，套餐到期后额度/目录读取时也会自动补领（30 分钟冷却）。
- 套餐名额：Lite 限量 1000 人/日；Pro 体验版每日 10:00 放 100 个名额。抢满时签到会失败并显示原因，明天再试即可。

## 选项（`plugins.json` 的 options；都有默认值）

| 选项 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `locale` | auto（跟机器） | `zh` / `en` |
| `autoVersion` | `true` | 原生 `auto_version` 开关的旧版覆盖项 |
| `clientVersion` | `5.2.3` | 兜底版本号（`autoVersion` 拉取失败或关闭时用） |
| `autoClaim` | `true` | 原生 `auto_claim` 开关的旧版覆盖项 |
| `masterKeyHex` | 内置 | 上游更换签名密钥时的热修逃生口（64 位 hex） |
| `platformBaseURL` | `https://acs.atomgit.com` | OAuth broker 地址 |
| `codingPlanAPIURL` | `https://api.gitcode.com/api/v5` | CodingPlan REST 地址 |
| `quotaTtlMs` | `60000` | 额度缓存时长 |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `32768` | 模型 output 上限兜底 |
| `diagnosticsPort` | `3478` | 本机诊断端口（`1024..65535`） |

日常建议使用原生开关，它们默认开启；可在供应商编辑器切换，或执行：

```bash
magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_claim":false}'
magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_version":false}'
```

插件清单默认允许每个 AtomCode 账号同时运行 8 个请求。只有多个 Agent、会话或
子任务并行时才会看到收益；单个流式回答不会因此变快。受控真机测试中，4、8、12
个短请求同时发出均返回 HTTP 200，没有出现 429 或 5xx，因此默认采用较保守的
8；仍可在供应商设置中按账号覆盖这个值。

## 安全边界

下面这些都在代码里强制，`npm test` 逐一覆盖：

- **只有官方网关是目的地。** `loader.fetch` 在任何异步读取凭证之前先冻结已验证
  的 URL，再把 origin 与 `https://llm-api.atomgit.com` 比对。调用方无法在等待
  期间修改 `URL` 对象把签名流量引到别处；协议和端口都参与比较。
- **上游改不动目的地。** 模型行里的 `base_url` 只有 origin 与签名网关完全一致时才被采纳，否则该模型回退官方网关并记录日志。
- **端点选项使用精确主机。** `platformBaseURL` 只接受
  `acs.atomgit.com`；`codingPlanAPIURL` 只接受 `api.gitcode.com`（允许改路径）。
  两者都必须是 443 端口上的 HTTPS；否则回退官方端点并输出脱敏告警。
- **读取有上限、跳转被拒绝。** 版本、OAuth、CodingPlan 的响应体都在流式读取时限制为 1 MiB；所有元数据请求都有超时且拒绝跳转。broker 返回的登录地址也必须位于 AtomGit。
- **只接受可精确签名的请求体。** 字符串、字节缓冲区、TypedArray、`ArrayBuffer`
  和 `Blob` 会按实际发送字节签名；流、`FormData`、`URLSearchParams` 直接拒绝，
  避免签的字节和线上字节不一致。缓冲的请求体上限为 64 MiB。
- **签名覆盖最终字节。** 流式 Chat Completions 若没有显式设置
  `stream_options.include_usage`，插件会补 `include_usage: true`，序列化后再签名。
- **日志脱敏。** 上游响应正文不会塞进异常；非法配置值、bearer、邮箱和长密钥
  不进入日志。
- **凭证失败与权益失败分开。** 401 或明确属于凭证/会话的 403 才允许触发一次
  续期；额度、套餐、权限等非凭证 403 不会让账号掉登录，并返回
  `x-magpie-sign-in: kept`。
- **诊断页只在本机、只读。** 服务只监听 `127.0.0.1`，校验 `Host`，API 需要
  每次进程启动时随机生成的令牌，POST 还校验 `Origin`，并下发严格 CSP。页面
  不会主动请求 AtomGit 或 LLM 网关。

浏览器凭证存在 magpie 自己的 `plugin-auth.json`。CLI 凭证保留在
`~/.atomcode/auth.toml`，续期时以 `0600` 权限原子替换并保留无关内容。凭证不会
被打印或写入日志，只会附加到上面两个精确官方主机。

Magpie 还会在 `<插件数据目录>/atomcode-state.json` 保存诊断状态。文件经过
schema 过滤，以 `0600` 权限原子写入；只包含模型名、额度窗口、版本来源与脱敏
后的最近错误，不保存 token、完整 user id、邮箱、提示词或上游原始响应。

### 装完就在跑的默认行为

两个默认开关都是开的，且都会在没被要求的情况下动手：

| 默认 | 实际动作 | 关闭方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_claim: true` | 登录后在后台启动 CodingPlan `claim-v2`；套餐到期时再执行幂等重领 | `magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_claim":false}'` |
| `auto_version: true` | 后台刷新 `raw.atomgit.com` 的版本清单（缓存 12 小时）。请求立即使用当前缓存版本，拿不到时使用内置兜底 | `magpie plugin options atomcode '{"auto_version":false}'` |

## 排障

登录或 `provider test` 遇到 401 时：

1. 运行 `magpie version`，确认失败阶段是 OAuth 回调、模型目录、额度还是真实对话请求。
2. 打开插件的 **AtomCode 诊断**页。状态摘要会区分“本地快照可读”和“上游当前可用”，随后按额度、模型、账号与版本展开；最近错误、离线自检和运行时信息位于下方，不会请求上游。
3. 用同一账号运行官方 AtomCode 客户端的 `atomcode login`。若官方客户端也返回 401，更可能是上游账号风控，而不是插件。
4. 提交 Bug 时附上诊断页生成的脱敏报告。不要提供 access token、refresh token、OAuth state、`plugin-auth.json`、邮箱、账号 ID 或未脱敏的用户目录。

安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私密报告；开发与审查约定见[社区插件指南](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins#write-your-own)。

## 开发

```bash
cd ../..
npm test                       # 在 workspace 根运行 Node 测试
npm run test:bun               # Bun 宿主/运行时测试
npm run test:coverage:enforce  # 行/分支/函数覆盖率门禁
npm run pack:check             # 检查 npm 发布包内容
```

真机验证会消耗少量额度，默认关闭：

```bash
ATOMCODE_LIVE=1 npm run test:live
```

脚本最多发出 9 次请求，关闭自动领取，不执行签到，也不会输出 token、提示词或
模型回复正文。

CI 会在 Node 20、22、24 与固定版本 Bun 上运行测试，执行覆盖率门禁，并把
打包后的 tarball 安装到空目录做导入冒烟。发布流程使用 npm trusted publishing
和 provenance，只由 GitHub Release 触发。

沙箱验证（不碰真实配置）：

```bash
SB=$(mktemp -d)
PLUGIN_ROOT="$(pwd)/packages/atomcode"
sb() { env HOME="$SB" USERPROFILE="$SB" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$SB/.config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$SB/.cache" \
  MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 MAGPIE_PLUGIN_MARKET=off magpie "$@"; }
sb plugin add "$PLUGIN_ROOT"
sb plugin list
sb plugin options atomcode
```

同一份代码可加载为 OpenCode 插件（v1 插件形态）；magpie 自有的 `auth.usage` /
`auth.refresh` / `auth.checkin` 会被 OpenCode 忽略。由于 OpenCode 的 OAuth 类型
没有声明 AtomCode 签名必需的 `uid` 字段，OpenCode 支持仍标为实验性，需通过真实
宿主契约测试后再升级。诊断服务和原生供应商开关仅适用于 Magpie。

本插件是非官方的兼容实现，不隶属于 AtomGit / AtomCode，也未获其认可。上游协议（签名密钥、OAuth、接口）可能随时变化；使用方式可能违反服务条款，存在账号受限或封禁风险——Atom2Api 项目有同类警示。请仅凭自己的账号、在了解风险的前提下使用。实现依据与署名见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. The format follows
Keep a Changelog and the project uses semantic versioning.

## 0.3.1 - 2026-11-15

### Fixed

- `glm5.3-flash` (and the other reasoning model groups the gateway treats the
  same way, e.g. `lumen-alpha`) answered 403 "access disabled by request
  policy" on every request: the upstream now requires an
  `x-atomcode-session-id` header on that group, and no signed request from
  this plugin carried one.
- The new `chat.headers` hook fills the header from magpie's own
  per-conversation session id (`input.sessionID`), the same scope the official
  client sends. On hosts or paths where that hook does not run (OpenCode entry
  points), the loader falls back to one stable UUID per signed-in account.
- Verified against the live gateway: the identical signed body passes with the
  header and fails without it.
- Ported from upstream `aqiu817/magpie-atomcode` (2026-11-15), where it was
  diagnosed and verified with three controlled probes.

## 0.3.0 - 2026-11-03

### Added

- Magpie-native `auto_claim` and `auto_version` provider switches, both on by
  default. The legacy `autoClaim` and `autoVersion` options still override them.
- A loopback-only, read-only diagnostics page at
  `http://127.0.0.1:3478/` (configurable), with token-gated state and offline
  signature checks. It never calls AtomGit and is not started under OpenCode.
- Crash-tolerant state under Magpie's plugin directory for last-good model
  metadata, quota snapshots, version provenance, redacted errors and self-check
  results. The file contains no access token, refresh token, full user id,
  email, prompt or raw upstream response.
- A custom `auth.toml` path prompt for the AtomCode CLI sign-in method, accepting
  absolute paths and `~/...`, with renewals written back only to that file.
- A shared failure vocabulary that separates credential failures from plan,
  entitlement and quota failures across models, usage and check-in.

### Changed

- The package now ships from `magpie-community/plugins` as
  `@jianmu-plugins/opencode-atomcode-auth`, with separate OpenCode 1.x and
  2.x entry points.
- Minimum Magpie version is now `0.1.2629`, which provides native provider
  switches and page services.
- The AtomCode diagnostics page is now a focused troubleshooting workspace with
  a local-status summary, quota-first layout, model catalog, progressive
  technical details and a human-readable redacted report.
- The default per-account concurrency is now 8 instead of 4. Controlled live
  probes at 4, 8 and 12 simultaneous short requests all returned HTTP 200 with
  no 429 or 5xx responses; 8 keeps additional parallel headroom while remaining
  conservative. Magpie's provider setting can still override it.
- Usage failures after a successful read now return the persisted stale quota
  snapshot with `stale: true` instead of replacing the account's windows with
  an empty result.
- Live model discovery falls back first to the account's last successful disk
  cache, then to the built-in snapshot.
- Only 401 and explicit credential/session 403 responses trigger a refresh.
  Quota and entitlement 403 responses keep the sign-in and add
  `x-magpie-sign-in: kept`.
- Quota rows are separated by explicit unit and window span, so a token window
  is not misreported as a call-count window.
- The diagnostics workspace now uses flat backgrounds and solid status colors
  to match Magpie's settings pages.

### Fixed

- Restarting or briefly losing the CodingPlan endpoint no longer hides known
  quota windows or the previous model catalog.
- Exhausted claim slots now produce `ineligible`; ordinary upstream failures
  remain `failed`.
- A missing native switch value now matches the settings UI's enabled default.
- The published package uses an explicit file list, so editor backup/upload
  sidecars cannot enter the npm tarball.
- Upstream legacy `window_token_*` fields that contain call counts are no longer
  mislabeled as token quotas. Token-only rows are inferred from token-specific
  fields without call counters; `current_usage` also requires an explicit unit.
- The embedded diagnostics page now loads inside Magpie's
  `sandbox="allow-scripts"` plugin frame, including its styles, scripts, images,
  token-gated API preflights and requests. Each page response uses a fresh CSP
  script nonce. Host and token checks remain loopback-only, and CORS never uses
  a wildcard origin.
- CLI-backed renewals preserve each existing TOML scalar's type, including the
  official CLI's string-valued `user.id`, and keep unmanaged fields such as
  `token_type`. A renewal can no longer make the official CLI reject auth.toml.

### Security

- Diagnostics bind only to `127.0.0.1`, validate `Host` and `Origin`, require a
  random per-process token for APIs, and serve a restrictive CSP.
- Persisted diagnostics state is schema-filtered, atomically written with
  `0600` permissions, and excludes credentials and account identifiers.

## 0.2.0 - 2026-11-02

### Added

- Second sign-in method that reuses the official AtomCode CLI's
  `~/.atomcode/auth.toml`, validates private regular-file permissions, re-reads
  shared state before use, and atomically writes renewals back.
- Live model metadata for `deepseek-flash`, reasoning-effort variants, and
  model-level output-token limits.
- Token-oriented quota windows alongside every call-count window.
- Opt-in live smoke test capped at nine requests, with automatic claiming
  disabled and no token, prompt, or response-content output.
- Isolated tarball install/import CI smoke and release publication workflow for
  npm trusted publishing with provenance.

### Changed

- Package name and layout are migration-ready for
  `@jianmu-plugins/opencode-atomcode-auth` under
  `magpie-community/plugins/packages/atomcode`.
- Minimum Magpie version is now `0.1.2563`; OpenCode loading remains supported
  but is explicitly experimental pending a real host-contract test.
- Endpoint overrides are restricted to the exact `acs.atomgit.com` and
  `api.gitcode.com` hosts on HTTPS port 443.
- Request bodies are normalized to replayable bytes, buffered with a 64 MiB
  cap, and signed after stream-usage serialization.
- Unknown quota values stay unknown instead of being reported as zero.

### Fixed

- A caller-owned `URL` can no longer be mutated between validation and dispatch
  to redirect signed traffic.
- Refresh results are cached by old and new refresh token, so persistence
  failures or a gap between renewal and save cannot trigger a second rotation.
- Gateway 401/403 responses force one refresh and retry; CLI-backed accounts
  persist the new credentials before the retry.
- Usage/check-in/claim work shares one request budget and one claim lock, with a
  bounded 18-second quota path.
- `auth.usage` returns `signIn: "expired"` on upstream credential failures.
- `remaining_days: null` no longer triggers a false plan re-claim.
- Special model names such as `__proto__` cannot alter the model result object's
  prototype.
- Upstream error bodies, invalid option values, emails, bearer tokens, and long
  secrets are redacted from logs and user-facing errors.

### Security

- OAuth, CodingPlan, and version response bodies remain bounded and redirects
  are refused.
- CLI auth files reject symlinks, non-regular files, and permissions wider than
  `0600`.
- The published package keeps zero runtime dependencies.

# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a credential leak, request-routing bypass, signature flaw, or other exploitable behavior.

Use GitHub's private **Security advisories** flow for this repository:

https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/security/advisories/new

Include the affected version, a minimal reproduction, impact, and any suggested mitigation. Remove access tokens, refresh tokens, OAuth state values, account identifiers, and personal paths from logs and screenshots.

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest published `0.3.x` release and the current
`main` branch. Older commits and local forks are not supported.

## Security boundaries

- Browser tokens are stored by magpie. CLI-backed tokens remain in
  `~/.atomcode/auth.toml`; renewals preserve unrelated content and use an
  atomic private (`0600`) replacement.
- Tokens are never logged or printed.
- Signed model traffic is restricted to the official gateway origin; redirects are refused.
- Configurable OAuth and CodingPlan endpoints must use the exact official hosts
  on HTTPS port 443.
- Upstream model URLs are accepted only when their origin matches the signed gateway.
- OAuth login redirects are restricted to AtomGit and metadata responses are size-bounded.
- Request bodies that cannot be replayed byte-for-byte are rejected; buffered
  bodies are capped at 64 MiB.
- Only 401 and explicit credential/session 403 responses may refresh the
  account. Plan, quota and other entitlement 403 responses keep the sign-in.
- The diagnostics service binds only to `127.0.0.1`, validates `Host` and
  `Origin`, requires a random per-process token for APIs, and sends a strict CSP.
  It never calls AtomGit or the LLM gateway.
- The persisted diagnostics state is schema-filtered and atomically written with
  `0600` permissions. It excludes access and refresh tokens, complete account
  ids, email addresses, prompts and raw upstream responses.
